title: Add GitHub AI inference client via OpenAI SDK
body:
Integrates GitHub's AI inference endpoint (`https://models.github.ai/inference`) using the OpenAI SDK, enabling chat completions against `openai/gpt-4.1` authenticated via `GITHUB_TOKEN`.

## Changes

- **`src/ai-client.js`** — new module exporting `main()` that initializes an OpenAI client pointed at GitHub's inference endpoint, sends a chat completion request, and prints the response. Fails fast with a descriptive error if `GITHUB_TOKEN` is unset.
- **`openai@6.35.0`** — added as a runtime dependency.

## Usage

```js
GITHUB_TOKEN=<pat> node src/ai-client.js
```
